narrative_summary:
**Executive Summary: Regulatory Compliance Update**

**As-At Date:** 2026-07-01

This summary outlines the regulatory impact of the Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026 on your business. Of the 7 rules evaluated, 1 is applicable.

**Key Finding:** Regulation 3 of the Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026 mandates specific labelling requirements for prepackaged food.

**Mandatory Actions:**
*   Update product packaging artwork to include mandatory declarations.
*   Ensure trilingual text (Sinhala, Tamil, English) with correct font dimensions.
*   Verify batch coding, net content, manufacturer name, and expiry date format.
*   Conduct a pre-market label compliance audit.
*   Audit current label stock and plan for compliant packaging transition.

These actions are crucial to ensure compliance with the new regulations.

evaluations.quote_span: business-to-business food products that are exempted from other labelling requirements in these regulations except the following mandatory labelling requirements- (i) common name (in either of the three languages); (ii) trade name (if applicable); (iii) net contents; (iv) date of manufacture; (v) date of expiry; (vi) batch number; (vii) manufacturer's name and address; (viii) distributor's name and address; (ix) country of origin in case of imported foods; and (x) a complete list of ingredients. Provided further that the statement "Not for retail sale" shall be printed on the label or affixed through a supplementary label of such business-to-business food products clearly and conspicuously in bold type and font size of not less than three millimetres (3 mm).
counterfactuals: If market.b2b_only were True, this obligation would apply.
